reviews.author: Carlom
reviews.comment: This is by far THE BEST barber shop I’ve taken my son to. Don is absolutely amazing!! I showed him what I wanted, and he did exactly that. He’s fantastic with kids. My son actually enjoys getting a haircut! They also have great hours which is very convenient. The before (black shirt) & after. Thank you soooo much Don for your amazing work!!! Only person I trust to cut my sons hair.

reviews.author: Nasaiah M
reviews.comment: been coming to this shop for 5+ years. doesn't matter who you go to, all the barbers give great cuts. my barber is Don and he cuts my hair exactly the way i want it all the time, even giving suggestions too. there's parking spots available, always making it quick and easy to get in and out. haircuts take a while to get but because they focus on all the details. 12/10 never gonna stop coming here 🔥

reviews.author: Jabaran Akram
reviews.comment: Great experience at Kings Barbershop! Plenty of parking, almost no wait time, and the service was quick and professional. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a hassle-free haircut.
